SMTO-MAN-0006 — That section isn't on this SMTO Manual page

GUID: 86cd55db-edf7-543f-86f9-ed1f522d0d6b
Slug: docs-section-not-found
Domain: MAN · Subsystem: docs

What happened

  • The Manual page exists, but the heading the link points to isn't on it. The heading may have been renamed in this version.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to open the whole Manual page and list its headings, then choose the one you want. This error comes with the page's current headings, so the right one can be picked from that list.
  2. If the link came from an older Conversation, ask SMTO to search the Manual for the topic to get a current link. Headings can change between versions, so old section links may no longer match.

What success looks like

  • The section you wanted opens, or SMTO quotes it.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, and say where the Manual link came from. Don't keep retrying the same link; it will fail the same way.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • get_section found the Manual document but no section matching the requested heading reference; the tool response lists up to 50 valid headings.

What this means

  • get_section finds the document but no matching section reference in the snapshot section map. Manual lookup diagnostics describe local snapshot availability and validation. They neither fetch external documentation nor rebuild content during rendering; generated-lane failure does not invalidate an available authored corpus.

Why this can happen

  • get_section finds the document but no matching section reference in the snapshot section map.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the current document outline and copy the exact section reference.

How to fix it

  • Pick an exact heading ID from the returned outline, or fetch the document without the #heading part, and retry with that reference; otherwise search the current corpus for the topic.
  • Choose an exact heading from the returned outline or search the current corpus.

Retry and execution caution

  • Choose an exact heading from the returned outline or search the current corpus.

How to verify the fix

  • The selected current heading resolves within the intended document.

What not to do

  • Do not invent references, read arbitrary files through Docs or retry in a tight loop.

Technical notes

  • Manual lookup diagnostics describe local snapshot availability and validation. They neither fetch external documentation nor rebuild content during rendering; generated-lane failure does not invalidate an available authored corpus.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
